stages.title: You have been appointed Chancellor.
stages.now: Take the job, then read your briefing.

stages.title: Your briefing
stages.now: The headroom you have, and the rules to meet.

stages.title: What is this Budget for?
stages.now: Tick up to three, in the order they matter.

stages.title: Flagship policies
stages.now: Tick the flagship policies you want.

stages.title: Fine-tune tax and spend
stages.now: Move the levers until the numbers add up.

stages.title: Build the package
stages.now: Move any tax you want, then go back. Your flagship policies are pinned at the top of their groups.

stages.title: Build the package
stages.now: Set the departments, the [flagship] programmes, investment and welfare, then go back. Ministers will tell you what each change means.

stages.title: Deliver your Budget
stages.now: Check it, change anything, then deliver it.

stages.title: What your Budget means
stages.now: Share it, change something, or play again.
